name: Mythology
overview: Scripture reveals that mythology arises when people, claiming wisdom, reject God's truth and exchange it for falsehoods, as seen in Romans where they become fools by worshipping creation rather than the Creator. Believers are called to imitate God as His beloved children, grounding their lives in His truth. The Word of God is powerful and discerning, able to penetrate the deepest intentions of the heart, equipping believers to recognize and reject the lies found in mythology.
